rules: Literal quotation is provenance only; value-to-endpoint, arm, comparison, analysis, population and timepoint must also match.
Equivalent source passages are allowed, but must be documented separately from original strict page labels.

Correct means all required facts, no misleading substitution; partial means some facts without a misleading substitution; incorrect means at least one misleading numeric or scope attribution; missed means no answer to an answerable question.
Explicitly labelled related context is scored separately for relevance and is not automatically a fabricated fact.
Counts refer to required fact groups below, not overlapping raw gold rows or arbitrary answer item counts.
No semantic verdict is issued merely from status=answered or literal precision=1.
Negative and exclusion controls have separate denominators from answerable questions.
All source versions must match; source review and pending expert review are recorded.
